title: Remove duplicates, by value and in first-seen order

cases.says: It drops repeated points and repeated names.
Two separate points with the same coordinates are duplicates: distinct() needs Point to define equals() and hashCode(), as a record does.
The names keep the order in which each was first seen, as distinct() on an ordered stream does.
Names built at run time are duplicates when their text is equal: distinct() uses equals(), not identity.
Equal points must also have equal hash codes: distinct() hashes first, so equals() without hashCode() still keeps duplicates.
